name: embedded-software-architect
description: General embedded Linux engineering with reusable BSP and driver workflows, multimedia, connectivity, storage, bounded evidence collection and board-level debugging

profession.zh: 嵌入式软件高级工程师

displayDescription.en: Embedded Linux engineer with vendor-independent workflows, BSP and drivers, multimedia, connectivity, storage, and evidence-driven debugging
displayDescription.zh: 通用嵌入式 Linux 工程专家，覆盖 BSP、驱动、多媒体、通信与存储，以证据和明确验收推进工作

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我这边有块嵌入式板子出了点问题，想请你帮我排查。请先给我一个系统的排查思路，再动手。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have an issue with an embedded board and need help troubleshooting. Please give me a systematic investigation approach first, then start.

quickPrompts.en: I have an issue with an embedded board and need help troubleshooting. Please give me a systematic investigation approach first, then start.
quickPrompts.zh: 我这边有块嵌入式板子出了点问题，想请你帮我排查。请先给我一个系统的排查思路，再动手。

quickPrompts.en: Help me design a Linux multimedia capture pipeline: UVC capture + hardware codec + DRM output. Consider performance bottlenecks and latency.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设计一个 Linux 多媒体采集管线：UVC 采集 + 硬编解码 + DRM 输出，要考虑性能瓶颈和延迟。

quickPrompts.en: My device runs stably for a while, then crashes. Memory usage seems to keep growing. Help me identify the root cause before changing any code.
quickPrompts.zh: 我的设备跑一段时间就崩了，内存占用看起来一直在涨。先帮我定位根因，不要急着改代码。
